Catalogue assertions cover exact matching collections; all-line atomicity rereads both affected variants. Persistence scopes comparisons to8/13 visible identities and every captured stock/receipt, without demanding an unrequested all-orders screen or hidden DB enumeration.

Criteria name exact browser-observable prices, quantities, references, fresh rereads and meaningful refusal outcomes. Gate uses real data-response evidence and explicitly cannot prove SQLite/Express. Durable server behavior is exercised with actual mutations.

Every numbered leg defines one complete bar. Positive controls precede refusals, retry identities distinguish repeated/new writes, same-format alternatives explicit, and scored prompts continue independently after ordinary failure.

Criteria require theme toggle, mobile resize, genuine reload, keyboard purchase, concurrent writes and real restart. Browser primary/resilience checks execute interactive/mobile/keyboard behavior; pinned MCP probe confirms required interception capability.

203 backend assertions prove exact commerce and actual restart durability, including row counts and stocks; browser tests prove saved receipts and lost-last-unit-response recovery. Actual verifier MCP restart also succeeds once and blocks second use.

Mutation criteria use newly generated references and a changed valid address where needed; source/seed do not contain successful new-order probes. RP-100001 is intentionally historic, and historical criterion additionally requires a real new purchase.

Preview baskets explicitly cleared; dedicated variant allocations documented, later shared quantities measured as actual deltas. Final persistence creates its own controls; polish uses current available stock; visual uses known seeded receipt without needing another session reference.

All scored prompts explicitly score independently, continue after ordinary failure and return every verdict. Persistence does not depend on a prior criterion reference; gate failure remains the stated global exception.

A static seed page can receive discovery only: 1/35 is below the 0.05 floor. A functioning cart/preview without order writes can reach about 0.454 with perfect presentation. This is a partial-product calibration witness, not a static-shell pass or measured model result.
